description: This file defines a static utility class 'NonCapturingTimer' that provides a method to create Timer instances without capturing the ExecutionContext, helping to avoid unnecessary resource retention in asynchronous operations.

classes.name: NonCapturingTimer
classes.description: A static utility class providing a method to create timers that do not capture the ExecutionContext.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a Timer that executes the given callback without capturing the current ExecutionContext.
